results.title: TwinMind for Desktop
results.content:
## Getting Started and Setting Up

Download TwinMind for your desktop (available for Mac and Windows), install it, then open it and sign in with your account. This also connects your calendar, so TwinMind can see your upcoming events and remind you before they start.

The first time you open it, it asks for a few permissions:

 Allow microphone
 Allow capturing meeting audio
 Allow detecting meetings & inserting dictation

Macapp install.png
> Note: You can change any of them later in Settings.

## How to Use the Desktop App

Once TwinMind is running, a small widget floats on your screen. Hover it for three options: open TwinMind, start a dictation, or capture notes. It's the quickest way to start either, and you can turn it off in Settings whenever you like.

Options.png [...] Options.png

### 1. Dictate Anywhere

Works in any text field and all your apps like email, docs, Slack, or search bars.

 Press and hold your dictation hotkey, speak, then let go. The text drops straight in.
 Double-tap it for hands-free mode. Single-tap to stop.
 Perfect text appears. It cleans up what you said first, so the text reads the way you'd write it.

#### Two dictation modes

You can switch between two modes depending on what you need:

 Fastest. About twice as quick, English only. Good for firing off a quick message.
 Most Accurate. A multilingual model that handles 140+ languages. You can also add a custom prompt that formats what you say, for example turning a quick note into a clean email.

TwinMind for Desktop dictation style screen with Fastest and Most accurate options [...] ## Change Hotkeys

 Dictation (Voice Typing) - Choose your hotkey. Hold for short dictation, double-tap for hands-free mode.
 Capture (Notes) - Choose your hotkey. Double-tap to start capturing, single-tap to stop.

## Customize Dictation Model

 Choose between Fastest (English only) or Accurate with Edits (140+ languages).
 Add custom instructions to polish your dictation output, for example turning a quick note into a clean email.

That's the whole app. Set it up once, and it's there in the background whenever you need it.
